beer_description: We just can't stop! Fantastic fresh Galaxy again! This time in a beautifully balanced Imhla. And one of our hop favorites makes it unique - juicy, opaquely hazy, filled with aromas of the most unusual tropical fruits at once, where the taste of papaya changes to juicy melon, and then turns into bright passion fruit with notes of almost overripe mango. That's right, our favorite juice in your glass!
